newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian April industrial output rises.
newsitem.headline: Italian April industrial output rises.

text.p: National Statistics Institute ISTAT gave the following provisional figures for industrial production, year-on-year, in April.
Note: (The industrial production index was rebased in January 1994 on 1990 levels, replacing a 1985-based index.)
-- Istat said average daily output, non seasonally adjusted but workday adjusted, rose 3.9 percent year-on-year in April after a revised rise of 0.2 percent in March.
-- Production of consumer goods, on an unadjusted basis, rose 12.3 percent year-on-year in April. Investment goods rose 2.9 percent and intermediate goods rose 8.1 percent.

-- On an adjusted basis, production of leather goods rose 7.4 percent year-on-year, textile and clothing rose 14.4 percent, non-metal minerals rose 6.1 percent, metals rose 6.0 percent, machinery rose 6.0 percent and transport rose 15.9 percent. Paper products rose 16.4 percent and refineries and carbon coke rose 3.7 percent.
